scope: Predeclared existing-runtime sensitivity on the same frozen paired queue. All permissions, candidate order, source bytes and verification barriers remain fixed.
default_arm: Use Lean v4.31.0 default server.reportDelayMs in both proof policies.
zero_delay_arm: Use -Dserver.reportDelayMs=0 in both proof policies. This removes the server's default diagnostic debounce, while keeping the same completed-version waitForDiagnostics barrier.
claims: This is an existing Lean tool setting, not a new preflight algorithm. Compare complete query-plus-full-proof batches only. Report default and zero-delay results separately.
